title: Seed Sprint
summary: Race friends on the same five-minute signal puzzle, then compare results with a link.
user: Puzzle friends who want to compare a five-minute daily result on the same fair board, with a link instead of an account or a real-time appointment.

evidence.quote_or_summary: The 2026 Show HN title explicitly presents a daily multiplayer word-puzzle PWA, showing active builder and player interest in daily shared-seed browser play.
The fetched Roll Solver page is the live product for that daily multiplayer-word-puzzle format.

recurrence: Daily puzzle demand appears across multiple 2026 browser-game launches; the direct daily-multiplayer example validates shared-seed play as a web-native loop.
current_workaround: Screenshot a Wordle-style score, coordinate in a group chat, or use an app-specific friend system.
incumbents_and_gap: Wordle, Connections, and Roll Solver make solo/daily puzzles habitual. Most comparison is score-only or tied to a particular word mechanic, leaving room for a nonverbal spatial puzzle designed around a compact replay link.
smallest_useful_product: A single daily 6x6 signal-routing puzzle: rotate a limited set of tiles to connect sources before the clock. Finish screen produces a spoiler-safe colored result card and an optional room link where friends race the identical seed. Non-goals: infinite puzzle feed, chat, user accounts, or paid hints.
success_measure: 20% of daily completers open a shared result or room link, and 60% of returning players complete at least three different daily seeds in a week.
monetization: free — the daily link loop needs no gate; a one-time archive of past seeds can fund hosting without changing fairness.
constraints: Publish a deterministic UTC seed; prevent result spoilers in link previews; store only anonymous completion aggregates; ensure every generated board has a verified solution.
why_distinct: It makes the shared seed and spoiler-safe comparison primary, rather than cloning a word puzzle's vocabulary mechanic.
